references.front: User cream paper bag covering the head: opaque black cross eyes, curved black smile, folded sides and jagged lower hem
references.topDown: User overhead view faces right; printed face and jagged hem on the right, folded roof and Y seam on the left

front.scaleRule: Multiply draw rect by portraitSize / 96 after translating to portrait center

topDown.orientation: Mouth and jagged hem face forward (-Y), roof folds extend backward (+Y). The +90 degree example has mouth/hem on the right and folded roof on the left.
topDown.layer: Side gussets, separate roof flaps with open Y seam, forward printed face; composite after head with matching head transform

colorBinding.recipe: Use the same SVG for every player. Do not tint paper or ink. Jagged hem gaps and narrow roof seams expose the actual avatar; no red paint or substitute player-colored shapes are embedded.

composition.originalEyes: Covered by the opaque paper, do not draw original eyes over the mask.
composition.openings: Actual transparent gaps at hem and roof seams; do not replace with fixed red.
